[operator-attested] Documentation continuity evidence for criterion c08-a3570574 at merged commit 43e822a83fc866f184073fbf08edcb6dd649dbf2:

- docs/release-notes.md:11-18 makes rebar bridge preview the primary read-only inspection/dry-run guidance and states its lock-free deterministic field-level manifest contract.
- docs/release-notes.md:20-26 explicitly preserves rebar reconcile compatibility, argument-less legacy defaults, the legacy uncapped LIVE historical tally/no-manifest behavior, and reconcile-check as a distinct lock-free diagnostic rather than a preview alias.
- docs/release-notes.md:28-31 records the production-workflow continuity mapping: dry-run to bridge preview, live to bridge sync, and reconcile-check remaining on rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check.
- docs/user-guide.md:380-382 and 420-425 direct operators to bridge preview to inspect proposed Jira changes before bridge sync applies them.
- docs/jira-sync-setup.md:159-163 and 228-232 distinguish reconcile-check diagnostics from dry-run/preview and document both primary bridge entry points plus the retained reconcile-check workflow route.

These are repository artifacts on the merged tree, not an external assertion; together they prove the requested new vocabulary, dry-run guidance, and old-workflow/output continuity.
